content:wysiwyg_basic:2:1.html:
The Salvation Army of Georgia's Planned Giving

Thank you for considering supporting the future work of The Salvation Army through the impact of your charitable legacy. We are pleased to offer you opportunities to realize the value of your estate for yourself, your family, and your community by supporting the causes that matter most to you.

We would enjoy hearing of the human needs that that you feel most passionate about, and how we can partner together to help alleviate those needs. As we learn more about your interests and your situation, we can help you determine the best ways for you to give that will help meet the needs that are most concerning to you.

There are many popular giving options for you to choose from, such as:

  • A gift in your Will (often referred to as a bequest)
  • Charitable trust
  • Gift of real estate
  • Charitable Gift Annuity
  • Donor-Advised Fund
  • Cryptocurrency
  • Endowment
  • Qualified Charitable Distribution from an IRA
  • Beneficiary designation in a life insurance policy, a retirement account, or a bank or investment account

A Charitable Gift Annuity, backed by The Salvation Army, can be a compelling means of giving that benefits you by providing lifetime income to you. If you would like to receive an illustration of how a gift annuity could work for you, please contact us below. If you would like to gain a greater understanding of how Planned Giving can help you achieve your charitable intentions, please click here to view our Planned Giving site which has more information about the giving options listed above.

Thank you again for supporting The Salvation Army's mission to meet human needs in His name, without discrimination. Please contact us if you would like to explore the charitable planning options available to you. We are glad to have a conversation with you and provide helpful planning resources.

Sincerely,

Doug Cozart
Divisional Planned Giving Director

Doug Cozart
Planned Giving Director
